description: Recurse: passes a signal out and back through an effect up to 16 times in one go, giving each pass its own polyphony channel

params.text: Sets how many times each input channel goes round the send and return loop, 1 to 16. Its display is yellow while every input channel fits within 16 channels and red while channels are dropped
Multiplied with the SCALE input to give the factor the signal is multiplied by, so the loop can ring modulate
Added to the OFFSET input to give the voltage added to the signal
Sets when the scale and offset are applied: 1Pre once before the first send, nPre before every send, nPost after every return, 1Post once after the last return

inputs.text: Multiplied with the SCALE knob to give the factor the signal is multiplied by; channels beyond those at IN are ignored
Added to the OFFSET knob to give the voltage added to the signal; channels beyond those at IN are ignored
Takes the processed passes back in, channel for channel with the send; unpatched it takes the send itself
The signal to be processed. Its channel count multiplied by the recursion count must be 16 or less, and channels beyond that are dropped

outputs.text: Carries every pass of every input channel, the input channel count multiplied by the recursion count, with the passes of one input channel consecutive
The signal after its last return, with the same channels as IN apart from any that were dropped

menu: Order of operation — Scale before offset or Offset before scale, and a small lamp glows yellow beside whichever of the two comes first
